subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should restart-drain bypass plumbing be allowed to become part of the public plugin SDK, or must it remain private to core-owned gateway restart code before this PR can merge?
rationale: The PR exposes enqueueInternal on a public ChannelRunQueue type exported to third-party plugins, and automation cannot decide whether that is an acceptable public security boundary.

options.title: Keep Bypass Private
options.body: Move the restart-drain bypass behind a core-private handle or internal wrapper so external plugins cannot enqueue work during gateway drain.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Expansion
options.body: Accept enqueueInternal as a documented plugin SDK contract after maintainer security review and compatibility tests.

options.title: Pause For Broader Recovery
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want the SQLite persistence/replay restart recovery path to own this class of message-loss fixes instead.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Private
recommendation.body: Move the restart-drain bypass behind a core-private handle or internal wrapper so external plugins cannot enqueue work during gateway drain.
